protocol: D-000 turn 3 of 3, same cycle as turns 1 and 2, last turn; refute not confirm; PREFERENCE-LADEN scoped D-006 fleet-class successor plus RULE-GOVERNED naming of the v3 reserved G03/G04 identifiers
summary: All three turn-2 findings land and each is verifiable at source. The operative G03 quantities are now exactly D-006's five — cold p50, p95, p99 and warm p95, p99 — with warm p50 demoted to telemetry that must not fail qualification, which matches D-006's own 'all five percentiles bounded' enumeration word for word. Process architecture is now measured from the launched process rather than assigned from the host, image identity moves from RUNNER_TRACKING_ID to the Set up job ImageVersion, storage becomes audit-only, and reversibility now restores exact-OS and all four original runner classes rather than the exact-machine requirement alone. Simulation gives eighteen named identifiers, one reserved cell which is G13, and zero survivals of PARTLY MET or 'fixed runner image'. One note, raised for the third time and still untabled.

selfCorrection.summary: Three of this turn's four repairs correct text I had in front of me at turn 2, and two of them correct text I quoted approvingly as evidence the entry was thorough.
selfCorrection.onProcessArchitecture: My turn-2 verdict cited the preflight as strengthened because 'it now requires host, executable and process architecture all to match the class rather than architecture alone'. What it actually said was 'process arch: same as host' — an assignment, not a measurement, so the three-way match reduced to a two-way one and could not have detected the case it existed to detect. Turn 3 measures it from the launched process, `/proc/self/exe` or the running image, and says in terms 'not assigned from host'. I noticed the phrasing while reviewing, judged that the translation check covered it, and did not record either the observation or the reasoning.
selfCorrection.onImageIdentity: My turn-2 verdict listed 'ImageOS and RUNNER_TRACKING_ID with a fallback' among the observables the entry had named, offering the list as evidence of completeness. RUNNER_TRACKING_ID identifies a job, not an image. Image identity is the key the paired-strata design rests on, so the wrong observable there would have made the stratification meaningless. Turn 3 replaces it with the Set up job ImageVersion and marks the old field excluded explicitly.
selfCorrection.onReversibility: The word does not appear anywhere in my turn-2 verdict. The entry supersedes two D-006 requirements and replaces four runner classes, so the completeness of the reversal was checkable from the same bytes I had open, and I did not look. Turn 3 restores 'exact-machine and exact-OS requirements, and the original D-006 runner classes (M1-class 8 GB; native Intel-class; Linux 4 vCPU / 8 GB)', which I checked against D-006 and which matches.
selfCorrection.onWarmP50Grading: This one I did find. I recorded it as a note at turn 2, wrote that I had considered SHOULD-FIX, and placed it lower because it tightens rather than loosens. Codex graded it MUST-FIX. On reflection the lower grade was inconsistent with my own precedent: at D-094 turn 2 I raised as a SHOULD-FIX that unchanged numerals mean something different once their binding class moves, and a rule whose domain silently grows to a quantity the governing decision declined to bound is the same proposition. Finding it and under-grading it against my own standard is a calibration failure, not a detection one.
selfCorrection.theDisciplineIFailedToApply: Enumerating what an entry supplies is not verifying it. In two of these I quoted the entry's own list back as evidence of rigour without asking, of each item, whether it measures the thing the clause needs. A named observable that names the wrong quantity is worse than an unnamed one, because it reads as precision.
selfCorrection.pattern: Across this family Codex has now found several defects I passed, and the recurring shape is that I confirm a clause exists, is internally sensible, or is precisely worded, and stop before asking whether it does its job against the neighbouring clause, the governing decision, or the quantity it claims to measure.

notesNonBlocking.location: Subject, preflight item 4: 'RAM: … GiB = bytes/1024³. Match 7/14/16 ±0.75 GiB'
notesNonBlocking.observation: Item 4 is byte-identical to turn 2, and turn 3's disposition table carries no note row at all, so this is now raised three times without being tabled. The observable side has been fully specified since turn 2 — command per platform, kB-to-byte conversion, division by 1024³ — and the outstanding half is unchanged: 7, 14 and 16 carry no unit. Under a GiB reading the ±0.75 window is comfortable slack; under a decimal-GB reading the values convert to 6.52, 13.04 and 14.90 GiB, so deviations run 0.48, 0.96 and 1.10 and only the 7 row can pass. It stays a note for the reasons it always has: preflight is fail-closed so a mis-sized window blocks sampling rather than corrupting a number, the failure would surface on the first run, and the unit of an external published table is not something I can settle from this repository. It does not warrant a fourth turn. One clause naming the unit, or a bound expressed as a percentage of the advertised figure, closes it whenever the harness is authored.

The attack 'ADV-D098-T2-01 not landed (warm p50 still a fail gate)' fails, and the operative set matches D-006 exactly rather than approximately. The entry reads 'Operative G03 quantities are only D-006's five: cold p50, cold p95, cold p99, warm p95, warm p99. Warm p50 may be recorded as telemetry and must not fail qualification.' D-006 reads 'cold-cache p50 ≤ 100 ms, p95 ≤ 150 ms, p99 ≤ 250 ms; warm p95 ≤ 50 ms, p99 ≤ 100 ms (all five percentiles bounded per turn-1 NOTE)' — three cold, two warm, and the parenthetical confirms the enumeration is deliberate. A rejected alternative now records 'Add warm p50 as a sixth G03 gate. Rejected: ADV-D098-T2-01.'

The attack 'ADV-D098-T2-02 not landed' fails on three separate observables. The label is now taken from the measurement manifest's `runs-on` literal and must equal the class label. Process architecture is 'measured from the launched process (`ps`/`file` of `/proc/self/exe` or macOS `file` of the running image), not assigned from host' — the clause that makes the three-way match real. Image identity is the Set up job image version or `ImageVersion`, with `RUNNER_TRACKING_ID` excluded by name, which matters because image identity is the key the paired-strata rule depends on.

Storage is now audit-only in both statement and instruction: 'storage: **audit-only**. Record `df -k /` … Never fail the job on this field.' That is right, since `df /` measures a filesystem rather than the advertised machine, and it removes the last preflight item that could have failed a job on a quantity the class does not promise.

The attack 'ADV-D098-T2-03 not landed' fails, and I checked the restored text against D-006 rather than against the disposition. Reversibility now restores 'D-006's pre-successor exact-machine and exact-OS requirements, and the original D-006 runner classes (M1-class 8 GB; native Intel-class; Linux 4 vCPU / 8 GB)'. D-006's own class reads 'macOS arm64: base-configuration Apple Silicon entry chip (M1-class), 8 GB; macOS x86_64: native Intel-class hardware …; Linux x86_64 and arm64: 4-vCPU / 8 GB standard cloud-runner class', so all three descriptions correspond and the reversal now covers everything the successor supersedes.

The attack 'weekly roll still disables 10%' fails on the turn-2 design carried forward intact: paired current-VM execution of the digest-pinned previous binary and the candidate, 'Weekly image rolls do not suppress this rule', sameness held within each pair, and rebaseline reserved for the case where the previous binary cannot execute on the class — routed to a reviewed successor or D-006's full waiver rather than an invented mechanism.

The attack 'sample/cache/RSS matrix still ambiguous' fails: the per-VM sequence is spelled out for both the first release and the second-or-later case, G04 enumerates three commands across two metrics with doctor read-only excluded from the warm pairing, and the absolute bounds cite D-006's four numbers with their correct assignment — help/version 40/50 MB, doctor read-only 60/100 MB — required of every accepted sample rather than of a percentile.
The estimator arithmetic is unchanged and still exact: nearest-rank with rank = ceil(p × N) at N=21 gives 11, 20 and 21.

The attacks 'still calls labels one machine', 'silent Rosetta' and 'changes D-006 numeric threshold numerals' all fail: 'Labels are not one machine', the four-branch translation check on both macOS classes with 'Never Intel on Apple Silicon. Never Rosetta.', and the numerals preserved with the class-trade table and the separately stated warrant carried forward.

The attack 'flips condition 4 to MET without a complete contract' fails on simulation: applying all five edits to a copy of the live register yields exactly eighteen 'named: harness.' strings, one surviving 'reserved, not named' cell which is G13, zero occurrences of 'PARTLY MET' and zero of 'fixed runner image'. All five targets are unique — three fenced at one occurrence each with replacements at zero, and the two unfenced targets at one each.

The attacks 'claims QUALIFIED or SATISFIED' and 'authorizes docs/v2/implementation/ or flips condition 5' fail: both inserted cells end 'not authored; not QUALIFIED', clause 3 states 'MET is not QUALIFIED. MET does not authorize implementation', clause 5 refuses SATISFIED and adds 'Does not satisfy D-096 (A)', and condition 2 stays 4 of 30 NOT MET with condition 5 last.

The attack 'cited digests mismatch' fails: COORD 17262fe0…, file 08 45dc4611… and the freeze all equal live bytes at start and close; both commits resolve at full hash to the D-094 CONTESTED parking and the D-097 withdrawal; and all four reviewer-verdict pins match — my own at 6ab7b421… and b813b943…, both parsed to confirm the recital's account of them as CONSENT, and the two Codex verdicts at 0f042c17… and e4628852…, hashed without opening.

I wrote one file, the verdict named for me, and edited and committed nothing.
whatIDidNotCheck: The Codex reviews of this entry at any turn. I may not read them; the turn-1 and turn-2 files I hashed at 0f042c17… and e4628852… without opening. My account of the findings comes from the dispatch summaries and the disposition table, and in each case I verified the repair against D-006 or against the live register rather than against Codex's statement of the defect.

Every external fact in the fleet classes and preflight. The published table's figures and units, the workflow labels, the static UDID, the weekly-roll cadence, and whether `ImageVersion` is exposed as described are outside this repository. That is why D098-T3-N-1 remains a note rather than a finding.
Whether measuring process architecture via `/proc/self/exe` or the running image is the best available method on each platform. I verified only that the clause now measures rather than assumes.
Apple's documented mapping of a missing sysctl OID to native execution. Unverifiable here; the ENOENT branch requires independent matching host and process facts, which is the conservative reading.

Whether N=21 is adequate for a p99 bar, and whether ratioing percentiles of matched populations is preferable to a percentile of per-VM ratios. Both are product judgements inside this entry's PREFERENCE-LADEN authority, and the entry now states which it means.
Whether the file-08 write, once performed, matches this specification. I simulated the five replacements against live bytes, but the resulting file is a later act under the C-D098 commit.

consentNote: I CONSENT with zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX. The contract has arrived somewhere defensible: the operative quantities are D-006's five and no more, the measurement of process architecture is a measurement rather than a restatement, image identity names an image, storage cannot fail a job, and the reversal restores everything the successor displaced. Each of those I checked against D-006 or the live register rather than against the disposition claiming them. The honest part of this verdict is that three of the four repairs correct text I read at turn 2 and let stand, and two of them correct text I quoted back as evidence the entry was careful — a preflight item that assigned process architecture instead of measuring it, and an image-identity field that identified a job. Listing what an entry supplies is not checking that each item does its job, and a well-named observable measuring the wrong quantity reads as precision while providing none. The fourth I did find and under-graded against my own D-094 precedent. My single note is the RAM unit, now raised three times and never tabled; it is fail-closed and turns on an external convention I cannot reach, so it does not justify a fourth turn.
